# The owner records them with "Recorder stt record" (tests/fixtures/speech/owner/, local only);
# "Recorder stt synth" renders them with Piper into tests/fixtures/speech/piper/ (committed).
# The expected intent of each id is in tests/OpenSkyAtc.Voice.Tests/SpeechSamples.cs.
